messages:
elaine-marketing: Quick heads-up — pricing micro-launch this Thursday. I put together a visibility checklist and wanted to run routing + webinar + benchmark narrative items by you all. Short thread, pls react with :thumbsup: if good.

mike-growth: sending it over now. want to confirm: we’re doing a soft release to existing trial users + a public blog post?

elaine-marketing: yes — soft release to existing trials first (email + in-app banner), public blog + benchmark narrative goes live 12 hours later. webinar scheduled 3 days after public post.

sarah-cs: FAQ microcopy needs to include callouts on overage billing and dedicated capacity — I’ll draft. also can we map incoming calculator leads to a special CS queue for high-value demos?

josh-product: for tier naming A/B test: variant A uses descriptive labels (Launch / Grow / Enterprise), variant B uses benefit-led (Flexible / High-throughput / SLA-backed). We should wire which variant the calculator shows via a query param.

harry-ops: for routing: set a quick rule in intake that inspects utm_campaign and calc_score. if calc_score > 80 route to "pricing-demos" queue, else "inbound-nurture". I’ll add the rule after you confirm the param names.

elaine-marketing: agreed. canonical params: ?utm_campaign=pricing_launch_0426 & ?pricing_score=<0-100>. We'll track conversions with an event `pricing_calculator_complete`.

launch-bot: Deploy scheduled: pricing-calc frontend v2 -> canary at 2026-04-26T14:00Z. Release notes: show tier variant by `?tier_variant=A|B`.

mike-growth: benchmark narrative: 3 short graphs — latency vs cost (hosted vs dedicated), customer story (startup using dedicated to cut token cost 45%), and product quote. Elaine — can you draft the blog outline? I can collect metrics.

elaine-marketing: Outline: 1) TL;DR with bench highlights 2) real-world use case 3) how we measured 4) how to interpret calculator 5) CTA to webinar + demo. I'll put a draft in the doc: https://redwoodinference.app/internal/pricing/launch-visibility (working doc).

sarah-cs: For webinar: prep 2 short demos — calculator walkthrough and a dedicated capacity case study. Add a live Q&A slot for routing questions. I’ll build the FAQ slide deck.

josh-product: Small tracking snippet for the calculator click event (copy into app):

```
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
function trackPricingCalc(resultScore){
  dataLayer.push({event: 'pricing_calculator_complete', pricing_score: resultScore, utm_campaign: getParam('utm_campaign')});
}
```

harry-ops: also add a webhook to post new high-score leads into #sales-pricing with a short summary and link to trial account. We’ll redact PII.

elaine-marketing: decision list: 1) soft release to trials, 2) public blog 12h later, 3) webinar in 3 days, 4) A/B tier-name test via ?tier_variant, 5) routing: pricing_score >80 -> pricing-demos queue + #sales-pricing alert, 6) FAQ microcopy update bundled with blog. If nobody objects by EOD I’ll execute. :rocket:

mike-growth: :thumbsup: from growth, will prepare the benchmark visuals.

sarah-cs: :thumbsup: I’ll drop FAQ copy by 10:00.

josh-product: minor ask — make sure the calculator preserves the variant if someone shares a link (persist in localStorage).

harry-ops: noted. I’ll validate routing in staging post-canary.

elaine-marketing: perfect — thanks team. I’ll follow up with the launch checklist and a one-pager for sales.
